overview.value: Global technology company specializing in internet-related services and products, including search engine technology, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, online advertising, and computer software and hardware.

value.name: Focus on the user and all else will follow
value.description: Prioritize user utility and clear experiences above short-term business gains.

value.name: Fast is better than slow
value.description: Build high-throughput, low-latency systems and iterate quickly to solve problems.

value.name: Democracy on the web works
value.description: Rely on web standards, distributed collaboration, and open ecosystems.

value.name: Great just isn't good enough
value.description: Set ambitious technical benchmarks and anticipate future scale and user needs.
